name: IWAS
author: Mr.Rafael
description: IWAS is a small music tool made for WASM-4: create a song within the console's limits and save it. Everything in the editor works with mouse or touch.

descriptions.en: IWAS is a small music tool made for WASM-4: create a song within the console's limits and save it. Everything in the editor works with mouse or touch.
descriptions.it: IWAS è un piccolo strumento musicale per WASM-4: crea una canzone nei limiti della console e salvala. Tutto l'editor si usa con mouse o tocco.
